claims.claim: Reasoning can be turned on for Gemini, Claude and OpenAI providers
PromptArena captures reasoning as the Message.Reasoning field
Message.Reasoning is a sibling of content and is not mixed into the answer, the exports, or the context passed to later turns
A wrong provider reasoning control usually yields an empty trace and a passing run rather than an error
examples/reasoning-test/ is a worked example directory
Reasoning is configured per provider under spec.additional_config
Model gemini-3.7-flash is a valid Gemini 3 model name in the example
additional_config.include_thoughts: true enables Gemini thought summaries
additional_config.thinking_level is a Gemini 3 field
thinking_level accepts low, medium or high
Model gemini-2.5-flash is a valid Gemini 2.5 model name in the example
additional_config.thinking_budget is a Gemini 2.5 field that caps reasoning tokens and counts toward max_tokens
thinking_budget on a Gemini 3 model returns no thought summaries and the run still passes with empty reasoning
thinking_level on a Gemini 2.5 model is rejected by the API with HTTP 400
Gemini omits the thought summary on some calls even when include_thoughts is configured
Model claude-sonnet-4-6 is a valid Claude model name in the example
spec.defaults is the block where temperature, max_tokens and top_p are set for the provider
defaults.temperature is dropped from the request while thinking is on
defaults.max_tokens of 4096 is the example value and max_tokens is a defaults field
defaults.top_p is a defaults field
additional_config.thinking_budget is a Claude field and must be at least 1024
PromptKit selects the Claude thinking wire format from the model generation, not from configuration
Claude 4.5 and older models use the enabled plus budget_tokens thinking shape
Claude 4.6 models accept either the enabled shape or the adaptive shape
Claude 5-series models use the adaptive thinking shape and reject the enabled shape
Sending the wrong thinking shape to Claude produces an HTTP 400 response
PromptKit drops temperature while thinking is on for Claude
The provider schema still requires a value for defaults.temperature
PromptKit raises max_tokens when the thinking budget leaves no headroom for the answer
Reasoning summaries are a Responses API feature for OpenAI
PromptArena defaults every OpenAI model that is not a -pro model to Chat Completions
gpt-5.2 is a valid OpenAI model name in the example
unsupported_params is a spec field that takes a list of parameter names
gpt-5.2 rejects top_p
additional_config.api_mode accepts responses, and responses is required for any visible reasoning trace on OpenAI
additional_config.reasoning_effort accepts minimal, low, medium or high
additional_config.reasoning_summary accepts auto, concise or detailed
Without api_mode responses, reasoning_summary has no effect and reasoning comes back empty
Requesting reasoning summaries requires a verified OpenAI organisation
With an unverified org the model still reasons and reasoning tokens are billed, but the trace is not returned
promptarena run accepts --ci and --formats flags
--formats accepts the value json
promptarena run --ci --formats json writes JSON result files under out/
Assistant messages in the JSON result have top-level role, content and reasoning fields under a Messages array
A short content value alongside a populated reasoning value shows the trace did not leak into the reply
Reasoning is shown in JSON results
The TUI shows a reasoning section labelled with a thinking emoji in the turn detail when promptarena run runs without --ci
Interactive and voice TUI sessions stream reasoning live
promptarena serve starts the web UI
The web UI shows a collapsible reasoning disclosure on messages for live runs and historical results, on either side of a tool call
The web UI does not stream reasoning token by token; the trace appears once when the message lands
The markdown report at out/results.md contains only the summary, per-run and cost tables
The markdown report prints a reasoning value against assertions that is the LLM judge's reasoning
The arena save stage stores reasoning on the message
Run results are rebuilt from the conversation store
Saved reasoning includes opaque provider-native signatures and encrypted blocks kept for intra-turn round trip
Opaque reasoning entries are 536 to 1288 bytes per message against Claude
Opaque reasoning entries are stripped before reaching the browser
The saved JSON holds the model's full chain-of-thought text
A one-step question often yields an empty reasoning trace
examples/reasoning-test/ turn 3 is a single addition that returns an empty trace while turns 1 and 2 do not
Reasoning is captured on both sides of a tool loop, before the call and after the results
examples/reasoning-test/scenarios/reasoning-tools.scenario.yaml exists
The prompt config allowed_tools field is an allowlist; a prompt with no entry gets no tools
A seed is sent only when defaults.seed is set to a non-zero value
The OpenAI Responses API path never sends a seed and logs a warning when one was configured
api_mode: completions is a valid OpenAI api_mode value
Reasoning summaries are returned only by the Responses path, so seed and summaries cannot be used together
unsupported_params is honoured for sampling parameters on both OpenAI API paths
unsupported_params is the spec field that withholds a parameter a model refuses
